title: Signal: Dependency metadata verification disabled
scope: A verification-metadata.xml file that declares a verification-metadata file that switches metadata verification off.
limitations: It matches a verification-metadata file that switches metadata verification off in the parsed verification-metadata.xml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A verification-metadata.xml that mentions a verification-metadata file that switches metadata verification off in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
